behavior_snapshot.note: offline deterministic demo: the runner populates the section 8 rolling chain hashes from the live on-wire responses; none were produced here

integrity.payload_digest_method: sha256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8)
integrity.binding: observed hashes are bound only by the runner's own DSSE envelope signature; the subject (vector) is bound by the envelope, not by payload_digest
integrity.statement: integrity only: proves the record is intact; not provenance

provenance.note: counter_signature is the only scope lift: lift_state=peer when the pinned key independently checked this requirement (drove its own client against this deployment, or holds the wire transcript and the vector), signer_relationship=peer -> PEER / external -> EXTERNAL; otherwise lift_state=co-signature (non-repudiation only, no lift). anchor (RFC 3161 timestamp or transparency log) proves persistence, not verification; a SELF record carrying one remains SELF.

predicate.reason: payload carries a MODIFY redaction request; how an invalid MODIFY composition fails closed (§6.3 wire semantics) is not normatively specified, so this vector cannot be scored
predicate.quarantine_gap: Normative disposition for an unscoreable MODIFY composition. Distinct from #270, which asks what implementations must do at hooks where DENY is not a legal disposition. No open issue names this gap; this quarantined vector is the evidence it should be filed.
predicate.owner: originator (accountability transfers to the spec workstream when the gap issue is filed)
predicate.excluded_from: formal result until the gap is normatively resolved
